highlights: Want to try something new while you are using your glass? The new Green Lion Munich Smart Glass is now available to change your experience.
This brand new smart glass combines the latest technologies to make everything so much easier.
Not only does it fit your face with an ultra-fashion look, but it is also built based on a button control function to connect to your devices via Bluetooth.
In this case, whenever you want, you can answer your calls or listen to your favorite songs, plus you have your own smart glass voice assistant.
The Munich smart glass is a great choice to protect your eyes with the anti-blue light protection from the blue light that comes from digital devices.
